questions.question: Actuals uploads replace the whole month. With 31 plants that is safe only if every SAP export is company-wide. What should happen when a later upload for a month is missing plants that the current active batch has, or contains a plant the master does not know?

Three new decision records support this plan: 0030 (the format outline is its own ingest object; plant-keyed budget batches; drift reported per 0023, never blocked), 0031 (the master is generated by a committed script from the client's mapping sheet plus a plant classification table), 0032 (Ask clarifications resume a selection through a typed continuation, starting with plantChoice). Accept all three, confirmed by Rahul Anand?
